_note: Held-out evaluation snippets, hand-written BEFORE any retrieval tuning and never used to pick weights or thresholds (those were fitted on the original 22 'dev' snippets only). Ground truth is the CWE each snippet was written to demonstrate. Closely related categories (e.g. CWE-77 vs CWE-78, CWE-862 vs CWE-639 vs CWE-284) are genuinely ambiguous, so exact-match accuracy is a conservative measure.

def parse_settings(text):
    return yaml.load(text, Loader=yaml.Loader)

def grep_logs(keyword):
    return subprocess.Popen("grep -r %s /var/log/app" % keyword, shell=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE).communicate()[0]

def can_delete(user, post):
    return user.is_staff or post.author_id == user.id or post.author_id is None

def is_internal(request):
    return request.headers.get('X-Forwarded-For', '').startswith('10.')
